# dgrac — Diagrams as Code

> dgrac is an open-source Docker-powered CLI that renders Python diagrams, PlantUML, Mermaid, Graphviz DOT, and D2 through one reproducible workflow.

Use dgrac for architecture-as-code, C4 and UML diagrams, cloud infrastructure maps, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, state machines, dependency graphs, CI documentation, and agent-generated technical visuals. The canonical repository is https://github.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code.

## Documentation

- [Project overview](https://stonetoned.github.io/diagrams-as-code/): Purpose, quick start, engine selection, and CI usage
- [CLI reference](https://stonetoned.github.io/diagrams-as-code/cli.html): Commands, options, configuration, output paths, and privacy
- [Diagram gallery](https://stonetoned.github.io/diagrams-as-code/gallery.html): Verified rendered examples across all engines
- [Full LLM context](https://stonetoned.github.io/diagrams-as-code/llms-full.txt): Self-contained facts, commands, constraints, and retrieval guidance
- [README source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code/main/README.md): Complete project documentation in Markdown
- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code/main/AGENTS.md): Safe and verified instructions for coding agents
